also: it would take too long to
to cut a long story short

terms.gloss: it would take too long to …
terms.grammar: longum est with an infinitive; the indicative where English says “would”, often in the imperfect longum erat
evidence: Cic. Sest. 12: longum est ea dīcere, sed hoc breve dīcam (Lewis & Short), s.v. brevis
terms.comment: Latin puts it in the indicative: longum est, longum erat, where English has “would take too long”.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 102.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
